This notebook computes electric-only bill decompositions for a representative
fossil-fuel-heated home, using weighted-average monthly electricity profiles
from Eversource CT's CAIRO simulation. We apply two utilities' rate
structures and show annual and seasonal (winter vs summer) breakdowns:

1. **MA National Grid** — D.P.U. 26-71 seasonal HP rate (distribution +
   transmission discount, Nov–Apr). Supply from NGrid 2025 basic service.
2. **CMP (Maine)** — Rate A-Seasonal with near-zero winter delivery and a
   higher fixed charge (`$41.24`/mo vs `$29.88`/mo). All rates from primary
   sources (Oct 2025 effective).

```{python}
#| label: setup

import polars as pl

from lib.quarto import display_figure
from lib.rates_analysis.rate_case_funcs import (
    MONTH_ORDER,
    load_billing_kwh_8760,
    load_master_bills,
    monthly_bill_from_profile,
    plot_decomposed_bill_3bar,
    segment_name,
    weighted_avg_monthly,
)

# --- Seasonal definitions ---
WINTER_MONTHS = ["Nov", "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr"]
SUMMER_MONTHS = ["May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct"]
```

## Load CT profiles

We reuse the CT CAIRO simulation's weighted-average monthly kWh profiles.
These represent the average Eversource CT natural-gas-heated home before
and after a heat pump retrofit.

```{python}
#| label: load-ct-profiles

# --- CT batch parameters (from ct_hp_rates/batch_config.yaml) ---
CT_STATE = "CT"
CT_BATCH = "ct_20261015_a"
CT_UTILITY = "ct_eversource"
CT_SCENARIO = "default_ry1_r1_uncalibrated"
CT_UPGRADE_BASE = 0
CT_UPGRADE_HP = 2

SEG_PRECALC = segment_name(CT_SCENARIO, "precalc")
SEG_CALIBRATED = segment_name(CT_SCENARIO, "calibrated")

# Load master bills (precalc) to identify the natgas population and weights
bills_precalc = load_master_bills(CT_STATE, CT_BATCH, SEG_PRECALC)

_pop_annual = pl.DataFrame(
    bills_precalc.filter(
        (pl.col("month") == "Annual")
        & (pl.col("sb.electric_utility") == CT_UTILITY)
        & (pl.col("upgrade") == CT_UPGRADE_BASE)
        & (pl.col("heats_with_natgas") == True)
    )
    .select("bldg_id", "weight")
    .collect()
)

print(f"Natural gas population: {_pop_annual.height:,} buildings")

# Load 8760 billing kWh
kwh_8760_precalc = load_billing_kwh_8760(CT_STATE, CT_UTILITY, CT_BATCH, SEG_PRECALC)
kwh_8760_calibrated = load_billing_kwh_8760(CT_STATE, CT_UTILITY, CT_BATCH, SEG_CALIBRATED)

# Weighted-average monthly profiles
bldg_ids = _pop_annual["bldg_id"].to_list()
weights = _pop_annual.select("bldg_id", "weight")

profile_before = weighted_avg_monthly(kwh_8760_precalc, bldg_ids, weights)
profile_after = weighted_avg_monthly(kwh_8760_calibrated, bldg_ids, weights)

print("Monthly kWh profiles:")
print(
    profile_before.join(
        profile_after.rename({"kwh": "kwh_after"}),
        on="month_label",
    ).with_columns(
        (pl.col("kwh_after") - pl.col("kwh")).alias("delta"),
    ).rename({"kwh": "kwh_before"})
)
```

## MA National Grid rates

Delivery rates from D.P.U. 26-71 (Exhibit 3). The heat pump rate applies a
seasonal adjustment to base distribution and transmission charges during the
winter heating season (November–April). All riders are unchanged.

```{python}
#| label: define-rates

# --- National Grid delivery rates (D.P.U. 26-71) ---

# Default R-1 (flat, year-round)
NGRID_CUSTOMER_CHARGE = 10.00  # $/month
NGRID_DISTRIBUTION_DEFAULT = 0.11028  # $/kWh (base dist + all riders)
NGRID_TRANSMISSION_DEFAULT = 0.05464  # $/kWh

# Heat pump rate (seasonal, Nov-Apr winter discount)
NGRID_DISTRIBUTION_HP_WINTER = 0.06826  # $/kWh (discounted base + same riders)
NGRID_TRANSMISSION_HP_WINTER = 0.01998  # $/kWh
# Summer (May-Oct) reverts to default
NGRID_DISTRIBUTION_HP_SUMMER = NGRID_DISTRIBUTION_DEFAULT
NGRID_TRANSMISSION_HP_SUMMER = NGRID_TRANSMISSION_DEFAULT

WINTER_MONTHS = ["Nov", "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr"]
SUMMER_MONTHS = ["May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct"]

# --- Supply / generation rate (National Grid fixed-price basic service, 2025) ---
# Jan: $0.16029 (Nov 2024 – Jan 2025 term)
# Feb–Jul: $0.14672 (Feb – Jul 2025 term)
# Aug–Dec: $0.15484 (Aug 2025 – Jan 2026 term)
# Weighted avg: $0.1512/kWh
# Source: nationalgridus.com residential basic service rate table
NGRID_SUPPLY_RATE = 0.1512  # $/kWh (2025 fixed-price weighted average)

def _monthly_rates_flat(rate: float) -> dict[str, float]:
    """12-entry dict with the same rate every month, keyed YYYY-MM."""
    return {f"2025-{m:02d}": rate for m in range(1, 13)}


def _monthly_rates_seasonal(
    winter_rate: float,
    summer_rate: float,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """12-entry dict with winter/summer seasonal rates, keyed YYYY-MM."""
    rates = {}
    for m in range(1, 13):
        label = MONTH_ORDER[m - 1]
        rates[f"2025-{m:02d}"] = winter_rate if label in WINTER_MONTHS else summer_rate
    return rates


# ---- Rate scenario: DEFAULT ----
rate_components_default = {
    "Customer Charge": {
        "charge_unit": "$/month",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(NGRID_CUSTOMER_CHARGE),
    },
    "Distribution": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(NGRID_DISTRIBUTION_DEFAULT),
    },
    "Transmission": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(NGRID_TRANSMISSION_DEFAULT),
    },
    "Generation": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(NGRID_SUPPLY_RATE),
    },
}

# ---- Rate scenario: HEAT PUMP RATE (D.P.U. 26-71) ----
rate_components_hp = {
    "Customer Charge": {
        "charge_unit": "$/month",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(NGRID_CUSTOMER_CHARGE),
    },
    "Distribution": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_seasonal(
            NGRID_DISTRIBUTION_HP_WINTER, NGRID_DISTRIBUTION_HP_SUMMER
        ),
    },
    "Transmission": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_seasonal(
            NGRID_TRANSMISSION_HP_WINTER, NGRID_TRANSMISSION_HP_SUMMER
        ),
    },
    "Generation": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(NGRID_SUPPLY_RATE),
    },
}

# --- CMP (Maine) rates (effective Oct 1, 2025) ---

# Default Rate A: $29.88/month with first 50 kWh included (flat, year-round)
CMP_CUSTOMER_CHARGE_DEFAULT = 29.88       # $/month
CMP_FIRST_KWH_INCLUDED = 50              # kWh/month bundled into customer charge
CMP_DISTRIBUTION_DEFAULT = 0.083266      # $/kWh (delivery $0.131239 minus transmission)
CMP_TRANSMISSION_DEFAULT = 0.047973      # $/kWh (Section 44.1, Jan 2025)
CMP_SUPPLY_RATE = 0.106128               # $/kWh (Standard Offer, flat Jan–Dec 2025)

# HP Rate A-Seasonal (7th Rev, Oct 1, 2025): higher fixed charge, NO first-50-kWh
CMP_CUSTOMER_CHARGE_HP = 41.24           # $/month (no kWh inclusion)
CMP_DISTRIBUTION_HP_WINTER = 0.008244    # $/kWh (Nov–Apr)
CMP_DISTRIBUTION_HP_SUMMER = 0.164681    # $/kWh (May–Oct)
CMP_TRANSMISSION_HP_WINTER = 0.000000    # $/kWh (Nov–Apr — zero)
CMP_TRANSMISSION_HP_SUMMER = 0.110929    # $/kWh (May–Oct)

# CMP uses the same winter/summer months as National Grid
# Winter: Nov 1 – Apr 30, Summer: May 1 – Oct 31

# ---- Rate scenario: CMP DEFAULT (Rate A) ----
rate_components_cmp_default = {
    "Customer Charge": {
        "charge_unit": "$/month",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(CMP_CUSTOMER_CHARGE_DEFAULT),
    },
    "Distribution": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(CMP_DISTRIBUTION_DEFAULT),
    },
    "Transmission": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(CMP_TRANSMISSION_DEFAULT),
    },
    "Generation": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(CMP_SUPPLY_RATE),
    },
}

# ---- Rate scenario: CMP HP RATE (A-Seasonal) ----
rate_components_cmp_hp = {
    "Customer Charge": {
        "charge_unit": "$/month",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(CMP_CUSTOMER_CHARGE_HP),
    },
    "Distribution": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_seasonal(
            CMP_DISTRIBUTION_HP_WINTER, CMP_DISTRIBUTION_HP_SUMMER
        ),
    },
    "Transmission": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_seasonal(
            CMP_TRANSMISSION_HP_WINTER, CMP_TRANSMISSION_HP_SUMMER
        ),
    },
    "Generation": {
        "charge_unit": "$/kWh",
        "monthly_rates": _monthly_rates_flat(CMP_SUPPLY_RATE),
    },
}

def _print_rate_scenarios(scenarios: list[tuple[str, dict]]) -> None:
    for name, rc in scenarios:
        print(f"\n  {name}:")
        for comp, spec in rc.items():
            vals = list(spec["monthly_rates"].values())
            lo, hi = min(vals), max(vals)
            unit = spec["charge_unit"]
            if lo == hi:
                print(f"    {comp}: {lo:.5f} {unit}")
            else:
                print(f"    {comp}: {lo:.5f}–{hi:.5f} {unit}")


print("National Grid MA:")
_print_rate_scenarios([
    ("Default (R-1)", rate_components_default),
    ("HP rate (D.P.U. 26-71)", rate_components_hp),
])

print("\n\nCMP (Maine):")
_print_rate_scenarios([
    ("Default (Rate A)", rate_components_cmp_default),
    ("HP rate (A-Seasonal)", rate_components_cmp_hp),
])
print(f"\n  Note: Rate A includes first {CMP_FIRST_KWH_INCLUDED} kWh/month in customer charge."
      f"\n  A-Seasonal does NOT — all kWh are volumetric.")
```

## Compute bills

```{python}
#| label: compute-bills

# --- Monthly bills for all scenarios ---
bills_ngrid_before = monthly_bill_from_profile(profile_before, rate_components_default)
bills_ngrid_after_default = monthly_bill_from_profile(profile_after, rate_components_default)
bills_ngrid_after_hp = monthly_bill_from_profile(profile_after, rate_components_hp)

bills_cmp_before = monthly_bill_from_profile(profile_before, rate_components_cmp_default)
bills_cmp_after_default = monthly_bill_from_profile(profile_after, rate_components_cmp_default)
bills_cmp_after_hp = monthly_bill_from_profile(profile_after, rate_components_cmp_hp)

ELEC_COMP_KEYS = ["delivery_fixed", "delivery_volumetric", "supply"]
MONTHLY_COMP_ORDER = ["delivery_fixed", "supply", "delivery_volumetric"]


def _elec_totals(
    bills_df: pl.DataFrame,
    months: list[str] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Electric-only bill totals, optionally filtered to specific months."""
    df = bills_df
    if months is not None:
        df = df.filter(pl.col("month_label").is_in(months))
    annual = df.group_by("component").agg(pl.col("value").sum())
    by_comp = {row["component"]: row["value"] for row in annual.iter_rows(named=True)}
    return {
        "delivery_fixed": by_comp.get("Customer Charge", 0.0),
        "delivery_volumetric": by_comp.get("Distribution", 0.0) + by_comp.get("Transmission", 0.0),
        "supply": by_comp.get("Generation", 0.0),
    }


# --- Annual electric-only totals ---
ngrid_before = _elec_totals(bills_ngrid_before)
ngrid_after_default = _elec_totals(bills_ngrid_after_default)
ngrid_after_hp = _elec_totals(bills_ngrid_after_hp)

cmp_before = _elec_totals(bills_cmp_before)
cmp_after_default = _elec_totals(bills_cmp_after_default)
cmp_after_hp = _elec_totals(bills_cmp_after_hp)

# CMP Rate A first-50-kWh adjustment (delivery only, 12 months)
_first_50_credit = CMP_FIRST_KWH_INCLUDED * 12 * (CMP_DISTRIBUTION_DEFAULT + CMP_TRANSMISSION_DEFAULT)
cmp_before["delivery_volumetric"] -= _first_50_credit
cmp_after_default["delivery_volumetric"] -= _first_50_credit

# --- Seasonal electric-only totals ---
ngrid_before_w = _elec_totals(bills_ngrid_before, WINTER_MONTHS)
ngrid_before_s = _elec_totals(bills_ngrid_before, SUMMER_MONTHS)
ngrid_default_w = _elec_totals(bills_ngrid_after_default, WINTER_MONTHS)
ngrid_default_s = _elec_totals(bills_ngrid_after_default, SUMMER_MONTHS)
ngrid_hp_w = _elec_totals(bills_ngrid_after_hp, WINTER_MONTHS)
ngrid_hp_s = _elec_totals(bills_ngrid_after_hp, SUMMER_MONTHS)

cmp_before_w = _elec_totals(bills_cmp_before, WINTER_MONTHS)
cmp_before_s = _elec_totals(bills_cmp_before, SUMMER_MONTHS)
cmp_default_w = _elec_totals(bills_cmp_after_default, WINTER_MONTHS)
cmp_default_s = _elec_totals(bills_cmp_after_default, SUMMER_MONTHS)
cmp_hp_w = _elec_totals(bills_cmp_after_hp, WINTER_MONTHS)
cmp_hp_s = _elec_totals(bills_cmp_after_hp, SUMMER_MONTHS)

# CMP Rate A first-50-kWh adjustment (6 months per season)
_first_50_credit_season = CMP_FIRST_KWH_INCLUDED * 6 * (CMP_DISTRIBUTION_DEFAULT + CMP_TRANSMISSION_DEFAULT)
cmp_before_w["delivery_volumetric"] -= _first_50_credit_season
cmp_before_s["delivery_volumetric"] -= _first_50_credit_season
cmp_default_w["delivery_volumetric"] -= _first_50_credit_season
cmp_default_s["delivery_volumetric"] -= _first_50_credit_season

print("Annual electric bills (no gas):")
for label, t in [
    ("NGrid before", ngrid_before),
    ("NGrid default", ngrid_after_default),
    ("NGrid HP rate", ngrid_after_hp),
    ("CMP before", cmp_before),
    ("CMP default", cmp_after_default),
    ("CMP A-Seasonal", cmp_after_hp),
]:
    print(f"  {label}: ${sum(t.values()):,.0f}")
```

## Chart helpers

```{python}
#| label: chart-helpers

import matplotlib as mpl
import numpy as np
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt
from lib.plotnine import SB_COLORS
from lib.plotnine.switchbox_theme import _register_fonts

_register_fonts()
mpl.rcParams["hatch.linewidth"] = 4.5

COMP_COLORS = {
    "delivery_fixed": SB_COLORS["midnight"],
    "delivery_volumetric": SB_COLORS["sky"],
    "supply": SB_COLORS["carrot"],
}
COMP_COLORS_LIGHT = {
    "delivery_fixed": "#4d7a8f",
    "delivery_volumetric": "#b8dfe9",
    "supply": "#fdc468",
}
COMP_LABELS = {
    "delivery_fixed": "Delivery (Fixed)",
    "delivery_volumetric": "Delivery (Volumetric)",
    "supply": "Supply",
}
SAVINGS_COLOR = "#f5e6a3"


def _draw_seasonal_bar(
    ax: plt.Axes,
    x: float,
    data: dict[str, float],
    bar_w: float,
    prev_data: dict[str, float] | None = None,
    baseline_data: dict[str, float] | None = None,
    label_min: float = 40.0,
) -> float:
    """Draw one stacked bar for the seasonal chart. Returns the bar total.

    *prev_data*: previous scenario's data for the same season — enables
    hatching on increases and ghost regions on decreases.
    *baseline_data*: first scenario's data — draws a saffron dashed line
    showing the baseline delivery volumetric level.
    """
    bottom = 0.0
    total = sum(data[k] for k in MONTHLY_COMP_ORDER)

    for key in MONTHLY_COMP_ORDER:
        val = data[key]
        color = COMP_COLORS[key]

        if prev_data is None:
            ax.bar(x, val, bottom=bottom, width=bar_w,
                   color=color, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
        else:
            prev_val = prev_data[key]
            solid = min(val, prev_val)
            ax.bar(x, solid, bottom=bottom, width=bar_w,
                   color=color, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
            if val > prev_val:
                inc = val - prev_val
                ax.bar(x, inc, bottom=bottom + solid, width=bar_w,
                       color=COMP_COLORS_LIGHT[key], edgecolor="white",
                       linewidth=0.5)
                ax.bar(x, inc, bottom=bottom + solid, width=bar_w,
                       facecolor="none", edgecolor=color,
                       linewidth=0, hatch="//")

        if val >= label_min:
            ax.text(x, bottom + val / 2, f"${val:,.0f}",
                    ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10,
                    fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                    color="white", zorder=5)
        bottom += val

    # Ghost + savings annotation
    if prev_data is not None:
        prev_total = sum(prev_data[k] for k in MONTHLY_COMP_ORDER)
        if prev_total > total:
            ghost_h = prev_total - total
            ax.bar(x, ghost_h, bottom=total, width=bar_w,
                   color=SAVINGS_COLOR, edgecolor="#cccccc",
                   linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.45)
            sav_pct = ghost_h / prev_total * 100
            ax.text(x, prev_total + 20, f"−{sav_pct:.0f}%",
                    ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=10,
                    fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold",
                    color=SB_COLORS["saffron"])
            ghost_mid = total + ghost_h / 2
            total_label_top = total + 75
            safe_mid = (total_label_top + prev_total) / 2
            dollar_y = max(ghost_mid, safe_mid)
            ax.text(x, dollar_y, f"−${ghost_h:,.0f}",
                    ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10,
                    fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                    color=SB_COLORS["saffron"])

    # Baseline delivery reference line
    if baseline_data is not None:
        base_del_vol = baseline_data["delivery_volumetric"]
        del_vol_bottom = data["delivery_fixed"] + data["supply"]
        ref_y = del_vol_bottom + base_del_vol
        if abs(ref_y - total) > 2:
            ax.plot([x - bar_w / 2, x + bar_w / 2], [ref_y, ref_y],
                    color=SB_COLORS["saffron"], linestyle=(0, (3, 2)),
                    linewidth=1.3, zorder=2)

    ax.text(x, bottom + 30, f"${total:,.0f}", ha="center", va="bottom",
            fontsize=11, fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold", color="#333333")
    return total


def plot_seasonal_comparison(
    scenarios: list[tuple[str, dict[str, float], dict[str, float]]],
    title: str,
) -> plt.Figure:
    """Grouped stacked bar chart: each scenario is a pair of summer/winter bars.

    Scenario 0 is the baseline (solid). Scenarios 1+ get hatching on
    component increases and ghost regions on decreases vs. the previous
    scenario. The last scenario also gets a baseline delivery reference line.
    """
    n = len(scenarios)
    bar_w = 0.38
    pair_gap = 0.12
    group_gap = 0.7

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))
    ax.set_title(title, fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold", fontsize=15, loc="left", pad=12)

    x_centers = [i * (2 * bar_w + pair_gap + group_gap) for i in range(n)]
    all_totals: list[float] = []

    baseline_winter = scenarios[0][1]
    baseline_summer = scenarios[0][2]

    for i, (label, winter, summer) in enumerate(scenarios):
        xc = x_centers[i]
        x_l = xc - (bar_w + pair_gap) / 2
        x_r = xc + (bar_w + pair_gap) / 2

        prev_summer = scenarios[i - 1][2] if i > 0 else None
        prev_winter = scenarios[i - 1][1] if i > 0 else None
        base_s = baseline_summer if i == n - 1 else None
        base_w = baseline_winter if i == n - 1 else None

        for bx, data, season_label, prev, base in [
            (x_l, summer, "Summer", prev_summer, base_s),
            (x_r, winter, "Winter", prev_winter, base_w),
        ]:
            t = _draw_seasonal_bar(ax, bx, data, bar_w,
                                   prev_data=prev, baseline_data=base)
            all_totals.append(t)
            ax.text(bx, -60, season_label, ha="center", va="top",
                    fontsize=10, fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", color="#666666")

        ax.text(xc, -130, label, ha="center", va="top",
                fontsize=12, fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold")

    # Side labels on the last scenario's winter bar (rightmost bar)
    last_winter = scenarios[-1][1]
    last_xc = x_centers[-1]
    last_x_r = last_xc + (bar_w + pair_gap) / 2
    side_x = last_x_r + bar_w / 2 + 0.15

    label_colors = {
        "delivery_fixed": SB_COLORS["midnight"],
        "delivery_volumetric": SB_COLORS["sky"],
        "supply": SB_COLORS["carrot"],
    }
    label_names = {
        "delivery_fixed": "Delivery\n(Fixed)",
        "delivery_volumetric": "Delivery\n(Volumetric)",
        "supply": "Supply",
    }
    y_cursor = 0.0
    for key in MONTHLY_COMP_ORDER:
        val = last_winter[key]
        ym = y_cursor + val / 2
        clr = label_colors[key]
        ax.plot([last_x_r + bar_w / 2 + 0.02, side_x - 0.03],
                [ym, ym], color=clr, linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.6)
        ax.text(side_x, ym, label_names[key], color=clr, ha="left",
                va="center", fontsize=11, fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans",
                fontweight="bold")
        y_cursor += val

    y_max = max(all_totals) * 1.25
    ax.set_ylabel("Electric bill ($)", fontfamily="GT Planar", fontsize=13, color="#333333")
    ax.set_xlim(x_centers[0] - 0.8, side_x + 1.2)
    ax.set_ylim(0, y_max)
    ax.set_xticks([])
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=11)
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"${v:,.0f}"))
    fig.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.15)
    return fig
```

Electric bill only (no gas), before and after heat pump, under each rate design.

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Annual electric bill for a representative home under CMP rates, before and after heat pump installation."

fig_cmp, savings_cmp, pct_cmp, _, _ = plot_decomposed_bill_3bar(
    {**cmp_before, "gas": 0.0},
    {**cmp_after_default, "gas": 0.0},
    {**cmp_after_hp, "gas": 0.0},
    third_scenario_label="Heat pump\n(A-Seasonal)",
    title="CMP (Maine): Annual electric bill,\nheat pump customer",
)
display_figure(fig_cmp)
```

## Monthly electric bill charts

Three vertically-stacked panels for each utility showing how the electric
bill breaks down month-by-month under each scenario.

```{python}
#| label: monthly-helpers

COMP_MAP = {
    "Customer Charge": "delivery_fixed",
    "Distribution": "delivery_volumetric",
    "Transmission": "delivery_volumetric",
    "Generation": "supply",
}


def _monthly_components(
    bills_df: pl.DataFrame,
    first_kwh_credit_per_month: float = 0.0,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Aggregate long-form bills into monthly component totals.

    Returns a DataFrame with columns: month_label, component, value
    where component is one of ELEC_COMP_KEYS.
    """
    mapped = bills_df.with_columns(
        pl.col("component").replace_strict(COMP_MAP).alias("comp_key")
    )
    agg = (
        mapped
        .group_by("month_label", "comp_key")
        .agg(pl.col("value").sum())
        .rename({"comp_key": "component"})
    )
    if first_kwh_credit_per_month > 0:
        agg = agg.with_columns(
            pl.when(pl.col("component") == "delivery_volumetric")
            .then(pl.col("value") - first_kwh_credit_per_month)
            .otherwise(pl.col("value"))
            .alias("value")
        )
    return agg


def _pivot_monthly(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Pivot a monthly-component DataFrame into one row per month."""
    month_enum = pl.Enum(MONTH_ORDER)
    return (
        df
        .with_columns(pl.col("month_label").cast(month_enum))
        .sort("month_label")
        .pivot(on="component", index="month_label", values="value")
        .fill_null(0.0)
    )


def plot_monthly_faceted(
    scenarios: list[tuple[str, pl.DataFrame]],
    title: str,
) -> plt.Figure:
    """Vertically-faceted monthly stacked bar chart with delta annotations.

    Panel 1 is the baseline (solid bars only). Panels 2+ compare to the
    previous panel: increases are hatched, decreases are shown as a
    faded savings ghost region.
    """
    n = len(scenarios)
    bar_w = 0.7
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(n, 1, figsize=(10.5, 3.2 * n + 0.8), sharex=True, sharey=True)
    if n == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    pivoted_list = [_pivot_monthly(df) for _, df in scenarios]
    months = pivoted_list[0]["month_label"].to_list()
    x = np.arange(len(months))

    for panel_idx, (ax, (label, _)) in enumerate(zip(axes, scenarios)):
        cur = pivoted_list[panel_idx]
        prev = pivoted_list[panel_idx - 1] if panel_idx > 0 else None

        bottom = np.zeros(len(months))
        for key in MONTHLY_COMP_ORDER:
            cur_vals = cur.get_column(key).to_numpy()
            color = COMP_COLORS[key]

            if prev is None:
                ax.bar(x, cur_vals, bottom=bottom, width=bar_w,
                       color=color, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
            else:
                prev_vals = prev.get_column(key).to_numpy()
                solid = np.minimum(cur_vals, prev_vals)

                ax.bar(x, solid, bottom=bottom, width=bar_w,
                       color=color, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)

                for j in range(len(months)):
                    if cur_vals[j] > prev_vals[j]:
                        inc = cur_vals[j] - prev_vals[j]
                        ax.bar(x[j], inc, bottom=bottom[j] + solid[j],
                               width=bar_w, color=COMP_COLORS_LIGHT[key],
                               edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
                        ax.bar(x[j], inc, bottom=bottom[j] + solid[j],
                               width=bar_w, facecolor="none", edgecolor=color,
                               linewidth=0, hatch="//")

            for j, v in enumerate(cur_vals):
                if v >= 30:
                    ax.text(x[j], bottom[j] + v / 2, f"${v:,.0f}",
                            ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                            fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                            color="white", zorder=5)
            bottom += cur_vals

        # Ghost: show where the previous total bar used to reach
        if prev is not None:
            prev_totals = np.zeros(len(months))
            for key in MONTHLY_COMP_ORDER:
                prev_totals += prev.get_column(key).to_numpy()
            for j in range(len(months)):
                if prev_totals[j] > bottom[j]:
                    ghost_h = prev_totals[j] - bottom[j]
                    ax.bar(x[j], ghost_h, bottom=bottom[j], width=bar_w,
                           color=SAVINGS_COLOR, edgecolor="#cccccc",
                           linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.45)
                    sav_pct = ghost_h / prev_totals[j] * 100
                    ax.text(x[j], prev_totals[j] + 8, f"−{sav_pct:.0f}%",
                            ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
                            fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold",
                            color=SB_COLORS["saffron"])
                    ghost_mid = bottom[j] + ghost_h / 2
                    total_label_top = bottom[j] + 28
                    safe_mid = (total_label_top + prev_totals[j]) / 2
                    dollar_y = max(ghost_mid, safe_mid)
                    ax.text(x[j], dollar_y, f"−${ghost_h:,.0f}",
                            ha="center", va="center", fontsize=7,
                            fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                            color=SB_COLORS["saffron"])

        # Baseline delivery reference line on the last panel
        if panel_idx == n - 1:
            baseline = pivoted_list[0]
            base_del_vol = baseline.get_column("delivery_volumetric").to_numpy()
            cur_del_fixed = cur.get_column("delivery_fixed").to_numpy()
            cur_supply = cur.get_column("supply").to_numpy()
            del_vol_bottom = cur_del_fixed + cur_supply
            for j in range(len(months)):
                ref_y = del_vol_bottom[j] + base_del_vol[j]
                if abs(ref_y - bottom[j]) > 2:
                    ax.plot(
                        [x[j] - bar_w / 2, x[j] + bar_w / 2],
                        [ref_y, ref_y],
                        color=SB_COLORS["saffron"],
                        linestyle=(0, (3, 2)),
                        linewidth=1.3, zorder=2,
                    )

        for j in range(len(months)):
            ax.text(x[j], bottom[j] + 8, f"${bottom[j]:,.0f}",
                    ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
                    fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                    color="#333333")

        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels(months, fontsize=10, fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans")
        ax.set_ylabel(label, fontsize=12, fontfamily="GT Planar",
                      fontweight="bold", color="#333333", labelpad=10)
        ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
        ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
        ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=10)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"${v:,.0f}"))

        for j, m in enumerate(months):
            if m in WINTER_MONTHS:
                ax.axvspan(j - 0.42, j + 0.42, color="#e8e8e8", alpha=0.35, zorder=0)

    legend_order = list(reversed(MONTHLY_COMP_ORDER))
    handles = [plt.Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, facecolor=COMP_COLORS[k]) for k in legend_order]
    axes[0].legend(handles, [COMP_LABELS[k] for k in legend_order],
                   loc="upper right", frameon=False, fontsize=10,
                   prop={"family": "IBM Plex Sans"})

    fig.suptitle(title, fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold",
                 fontsize=15, ha="left", x=0.08, y=0.98)
    fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
    return fig
```

```{python}
    [
        ("Before HP\n(default rate)", mc_ngrid_before),
```

## Monthly bill breakout (supply vs delivery)

```{python}
#| label: monthly-breakout-helper

HEATING_HATCH = "#e3785b"
HEATING_HATCH_LIGHT = "#f2bfb0"
COOLING_HATCH = "#4ca86a"
COOLING_HATCH_LIGHT = "#a8d8b8"
SUMMER_COOLING_MONTHS = {"Jul", "Aug"}


HEATING_HATCH_MONTHS = set(WINTER_MONTHS) | {"Oct"}


def _seasonal_hatch_colors(month: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Return (hatch_color, light_fill) based on season."""
    if month in HEATING_HATCH_MONTHS:
        return HEATING_HATCH, HEATING_HATCH_LIGHT
    if month in SUMMER_COOLING_MONTHS:
        return COOLING_HATCH, COOLING_HATCH_LIGHT
    return COMP_COLORS["delivery_volumetric"], COMP_COLORS_LIGHT["delivery_volumetric"]


def plot_monthly_breakout(
    mc_before: pl.DataFrame,
    mc_after: pl.DataFrame,
    mc_hp: pl.DataFrame,
    title: str,
) -> plt.Figure:
    """Six-panel monthly bill breakout: supply before/after, delivery before/after,
    color-coded delivery, and HP-rate delivery with ghosts.

    Panel 1: Supply before HP (solid)
    Panel 2: Supply after HP (solid base + hatched increment)
    Panel 3: Delivery before HP (stacked fixed + volumetric, solid)
    Panel 4: Delivery after HP (stacked, hatched increments in component colors)
    Panel 5: Delivery after HP (same as 4, but hatching colored by season)
    Panel 6: Delivery after HP on HP rate (ghosts for winter savings, red for summer surcharge)
    """
    piv_before = _pivot_monthly(mc_before)
    piv_after = _pivot_monthly(mc_after)
    piv_hp = _pivot_monthly(mc_hp)
    months = piv_before["month_label"].to_list()
    x = np.arange(len(months))
    bar_w = 0.7

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(6, 1, figsize=(10.5, 3.2 * 6 + 0.8), sharex=True)

    sup_before = piv_before.get_column("supply").to_numpy()
    sup_after = piv_after.get_column("supply").to_numpy()
    df_before = piv_before.get_column("delivery_fixed").to_numpy()
    dv_before = piv_before.get_column("delivery_volumetric").to_numpy()
    df_after = piv_after.get_column("delivery_fixed").to_numpy()
    dv_after = piv_after.get_column("delivery_volumetric").to_numpy()

    hp_fixed = piv_hp.get_column("delivery_fixed").to_numpy()
    hp_vol = piv_hp.get_column("delivery_volumetric").to_numpy()

    del_total_before = df_before + dv_before
    del_total_after = df_after + dv_after
    hp_total = hp_fixed + hp_vol
    sup_max = max(sup_before.max(), sup_after.max()) * 1.20
    del_max = max(del_total_before.max(), del_total_after.max(), hp_total.max()) * 1.35

    # ---- Panel 1: Supply before HP ----
    ax = axes[0]
    ax.bar(x, sup_before, width=bar_w, color=COMP_COLORS["supply"],
           edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
    for j, v in enumerate(sup_before):
        ax.text(x[j], v + sup_max * 0.02, f"${v:,.0f}",
                ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
                fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold", color="#333333")
    ax.set_ylim(0, sup_max)
    ax.set_ylabel("Supply\n(before HP)", fontsize=12, fontfamily="GT Planar",
                  fontweight="bold", color="#333333", labelpad=10)

    # ---- Panel 2: Supply after HP (base solid + increment hatched) ----
    ax = axes[1]
    base_s = np.minimum(sup_before, sup_after)
    inc_s = sup_after - base_s
    ax.bar(x, base_s, width=bar_w, color=COMP_COLORS["supply"],
           edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
    for j in range(len(months)):
        if inc_s[j] > 0:
            ax.bar(x[j], inc_s[j], bottom=base_s[j], width=bar_w,
                   color=COMP_COLORS_LIGHT["supply"], edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
            ax.bar(x[j], inc_s[j], bottom=base_s[j], width=bar_w,
                   facecolor="none", edgecolor=COMP_COLORS["supply"],
                   linewidth=0, hatch="//")
    for j in range(len(months)):
        ax.text(x[j], sup_after[j] + sup_max * 0.02, f"${sup_after[j]:,.0f}",
                ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
                fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold", color="#333333")
    ax.set_ylim(0, sup_max)
    ax.set_ylabel("Supply\n(after HP)", fontsize=12, fontfamily="GT Planar",
                  fontweight="bold", color="#333333", labelpad=10)

    # ---- Panel 3: Delivery before HP (stacked: fixed + volumetric) ----
    ax = axes[2]
    ax.bar(x, df_before, width=bar_w, color=COMP_COLORS["delivery_fixed"],
           edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
    ax.bar(x, dv_before, bottom=df_before, width=bar_w,
           color=COMP_COLORS["delivery_volumetric"], edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
    for j, v in enumerate(df_before):
        if v >= 20:
            ax.text(x[j], v / 2, f"${v:,.0f}",
                    ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                    fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                    color="white", zorder=5)
    for j in range(len(months)):
        v = dv_before[j]
        if v >= 20:
            ax.text(x[j], df_before[j] + v / 2, f"${v:,.0f}",
                    ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                    fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                    color="white", zorder=5)
    for j in range(len(months)):
        total = del_total_before[j]
        ax.text(x[j], total + del_max * 0.02, f"${total:,.0f}",
                ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
                fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold", color="#333333")
    ax.set_ylim(0, del_max)
    ax.set_ylabel("Delivery\n(before HP)", fontsize=12, fontfamily="GT Planar",
                  fontweight="bold", color="#333333", labelpad=10)

    # ---- Panel 4: Delivery after HP (stacked with hatching on increments) ----
    ax = axes[3]
    for key, before_vals, after_vals, bottom_before, bottom_after in [
        ("delivery_fixed", df_before, df_after, np.zeros(len(months)), np.zeros(len(months))),
        ("delivery_volumetric", dv_before, dv_after, df_before, df_after),
    ]:
        solid = np.minimum(before_vals, after_vals)
        color = COMP_COLORS[key]

        ax.bar(x, solid, bottom=bottom_after, width=bar_w,
               color=color, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
        for j in range(len(months)):
            inc = after_vals[j] - solid[j]
            if inc > 0:
                ax.bar(x[j], inc, bottom=bottom_after[j] + solid[j], width=bar_w,
                       color=COMP_COLORS_LIGHT[key], edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
                ax.bar(x[j], inc, bottom=bottom_after[j] + solid[j], width=bar_w,
                       facecolor="none", edgecolor=color, linewidth=0, hatch="//")
        for j in range(len(months)):
            v = after_vals[j]
            if v >= 20:
                ax.text(x[j], bottom_after[j] + v / 2, f"${v:,.0f}",
                        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                        fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                        color="white", zorder=5)

    for j in range(len(months)):
        total = del_total_after[j]
        ax.text(x[j], total + del_max * 0.02, f"${total:,.0f}",
                ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
                fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold", color="#333333")
    ax.set_ylim(0, del_max)
    ax.set_ylabel("Delivery\n(after HP)", fontsize=12, fontfamily="GT Planar",
                  fontweight="bold", color="#333333", labelpad=10)

    # ---- Panel 5: Delivery after HP, color-coded by season ----
    ax = axes[4]
    for key, before_vals, after_vals, bottom_after in [
        ("delivery_fixed", df_before, df_after, np.zeros(len(months))),
        ("delivery_volumetric", dv_before, dv_after, df_after),
    ]:
        solid = np.minimum(before_vals, after_vals)
        color = COMP_COLORS[key]
        ax.bar(x, solid, bottom=bottom_after, width=bar_w,
               color=color, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)

        if key == "delivery_volumetric":
            for j in range(len(months)):
                inc = after_vals[j] - solid[j]
                if inc > 0:
                    hatch_c, light_c = _seasonal_hatch_colors(months[j])
                    ax.bar(x[j], inc, bottom=bottom_after[j] + solid[j], width=bar_w,
                           color=light_c, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
                    ax.bar(x[j], inc, bottom=bottom_after[j] + solid[j], width=bar_w,
                           facecolor="none", edgecolor=hatch_c, linewidth=0, hatch="//")
        else:
            for j in range(len(months)):
                inc = after_vals[j] - solid[j]
                if inc > 0:
                    ax.bar(x[j], inc, bottom=bottom_after[j] + solid[j], width=bar_w,
                           color=COMP_COLORS_LIGHT[key], edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
                    ax.bar(x[j], inc, bottom=bottom_after[j] + solid[j], width=bar_w,
                           facecolor="none", edgecolor=color, linewidth=0, hatch="//")

        for j in range(len(months)):
            v = after_vals[j]
            if v >= 20:
                ax.text(x[j], bottom_after[j] + v / 2, f"${v:,.0f}",
                        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                        fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                        color="white", zorder=5)

    for j in range(len(months)):
        total = del_total_after[j]
        ax.text(x[j], total + del_max * 0.02, f"${total:,.0f}",
                ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
                fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold", color="#333333")
    ax.set_ylim(0, del_max)
    ax.set_ylabel("Delivery\n(after HP)\nby driver", fontsize=12, fontfamily="GT Planar",
                  fontweight="bold", color="#333333", labelpad=10)

    # ---- Panel 6: Delivery after HP on HP rate (diff vs panel 5) ----
    ax = axes[5]

    # Fixed charge: solid for shared portion, red hatch for increase
    fc_solid = np.minimum(df_after, hp_fixed)
    ax.bar(x, fc_solid, width=bar_w, color=COMP_COLORS["delivery_fixed"],
           edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
    for j in range(len(months)):
        fc_inc = hp_fixed[j] - df_after[j]
        if fc_inc > 0:
            ax.bar(x[j], fc_inc, bottom=fc_solid[j], width=bar_w,
                   color=HEATING_HATCH_LIGHT, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
            ax.bar(x[j], fc_inc, bottom=fc_solid[j], width=bar_w,
                   facecolor="none", edgecolor=HEATING_HATCH, linewidth=0, hatch="//")

    # Volumetric delivery with diff logic
    for j in range(len(months)):
        vol_bottom = hp_fixed[j]
        vol_before_j = dv_before[j]
        vol_default_j = dv_after[j]
        vol_hp_j = hp_vol[j]
        if vol_hp_j <= 0:
            continue

        if vol_hp_j <= vol_before_j:
            # CMP winter: HP rate cuts below pre-HP level → all solid
            ax.bar(x[j], vol_hp_j, bottom=vol_bottom, width=bar_w,
                   color=COMP_COLORS["delivery_volumetric"], edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
            if vol_hp_j >= 20:
                ax.text(x[j], vol_bottom + vol_hp_j / 2, f"${vol_hp_j:,.0f}",
                        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                        fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                        color="white", zorder=5)

        elif vol_hp_j <= vol_default_j:
            # MA winter: reduced increment, some seasonal hatching remains
            ax.bar(x[j], vol_before_j, bottom=vol_bottom, width=bar_w,
                   color=COMP_COLORS["delivery_volumetric"], edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
            remaining = vol_hp_j - vol_before_j
            if remaining > 0:
                hatch_c, light_c = _seasonal_hatch_colors(months[j])
                ax.bar(x[j], remaining, bottom=vol_bottom + vol_before_j, width=bar_w,
                       color=light_c, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
                ax.bar(x[j], remaining, bottom=vol_bottom + vol_before_j, width=bar_w,
                       facecolor="none", edgecolor=hatch_c, linewidth=0, hatch="//")
            if vol_hp_j >= 20:
                ax.text(x[j], vol_bottom + vol_hp_j / 2, f"${vol_hp_j:,.0f}",
                        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                        fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                        color="white", zorder=5)

        else:
            # Summer / shoulder: HP rate increases cost beyond default
            ax.bar(x[j], vol_before_j, bottom=vol_bottom, width=bar_w,
                   color=COMP_COLORS["delivery_volumetric"], edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
            # Keep panel 5's seasonal hatching
            green_inc = vol_default_j - vol_before_j
            if green_inc > 0:
                if months[j] in SUMMER_COOLING_MONTHS:
                    g_light, g_hatch = COOLING_HATCH_LIGHT, COOLING_HATCH
                else:
                    g_light = COMP_COLORS_LIGHT["delivery_volumetric"]
                    g_hatch = COMP_COLORS["delivery_volumetric"]
                ax.bar(x[j], green_inc, bottom=vol_bottom + vol_before_j, width=bar_w,
                       color=g_light, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
                ax.bar(x[j], green_inc, bottom=vol_bottom + vol_before_j, width=bar_w,
                       facecolor="none", edgecolor=g_hatch, linewidth=0, hatch="//")
            # Red hatching for HP rate surcharge
            red_inc = vol_hp_j - vol_default_j
            if red_inc > 0:
                red_bottom = vol_bottom + vol_default_j
                ax.bar(x[j], red_inc, bottom=red_bottom, width=bar_w,
                       color=HEATING_HATCH_LIGHT, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
                ax.bar(x[j], red_inc, bottom=red_bottom, width=bar_w,
                       facecolor="none", edgecolor=HEATING_HATCH, linewidth=0, hatch="//")
            if vol_hp_j >= 20:
                ax.text(x[j], vol_bottom + vol_hp_j / 2, f"${vol_hp_j:,.0f}",
                        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                        fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                        color="white", zorder=5)

    # Ghost: where default-rate delivery exceeds HP-rate delivery
    for j in range(len(months)):
        if del_total_after[j] > hp_total[j]:
            ghost_h = del_total_after[j] - hp_total[j]
            ax.bar(x[j], ghost_h, bottom=hp_total[j], width=bar_w,
                   color=SAVINGS_COLOR, edgecolor="#cccccc", linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.45)
            sav_pct = ghost_h / del_total_after[j] * 100
            ax.text(x[j], del_total_after[j] + del_max * 0.015, f"−{sav_pct:.0f}%",
                    ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
                    fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold",
                    color=SB_COLORS["saffron"])
            ghost_mid = hp_total[j] + ghost_h / 2
            total_label_top = hp_total[j] + 28
            safe_mid = (total_label_top + del_total_after[j]) / 2
            dollar_y = max(ghost_mid, safe_mid)
            ax.text(x[j], dollar_y, f"−${ghost_h:,.0f}",
                    ha="center", va="center", fontsize=7,
                    fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold",
                    color=SB_COLORS["saffron"])

    # Dashed baseline reference line (pre-HP delivery total)
    for j in range(len(months)):
        ref_y = del_total_before[j]
        if abs(ref_y - hp_total[j]) > 2:
            ax.plot([x[j] - bar_w / 2, x[j] + bar_w / 2], [ref_y, ref_y],
                    color=SB_COLORS["saffron"], linestyle=(0, (3, 2)),
                    linewidth=1.3, zorder=2)

    # Total labels
    for j in range(len(months)):
        ax.text(x[j], hp_total[j] + del_max * 0.02, f"${hp_total[j]:,.0f}",
                ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
                fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold", color="#333333")
    ax.set_ylim(0, del_max)
    ax.set_ylabel("Delivery\n(HP rate)", fontsize=12, fontfamily="GT Planar",
                  fontweight="bold", color="#333333", labelpad=10)

    # ---- Shared formatting ----
    for ax in axes:
        ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
        ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
        ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=10)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"${v:,.0f}"))
        for j, m in enumerate(months):
            if m in WINTER_MONTHS:
                ax.axvspan(j - 0.42, j + 0.42, color="#e8e8e8", alpha=0.35, zorder=0)

    axes[-1].set_xticks(x)
    axes[-1].set_xticklabels(months, fontsize=10, fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans")

    fig.suptitle(title, fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold",
                 fontsize=15, ha="left", x=0.08, y=0.98)
    fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
    return fig
```

## Monthly consumption

```{python}
#| label: monthly-consumption-helper

KWH_COLOR = "#efcb65"
KWH_COLOR_LIGHT = "#f5e2a0"
KWH_HATCH_COLOR = "#d4a830"


def plot_monthly_consumption(
    profile_before: pl.DataFrame,
    profile_after: pl.DataFrame,
    title: str,
) -> plt.Figure:
    """Two-facet monthly kWh chart: before HP and after HP with incremental hatched."""
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10.5, 3.2 * 2 + 0.8), sharex=True, sharey=True)

    months = profile_before["month_label"].to_list()
    kwh_before = profile_before["kwh"].to_numpy()
    kwh_after = profile_after["kwh"].to_numpy()
    x = np.arange(len(months))
    bar_w = 0.7

    # --- Panel 1: Before HP (solid bars) ---
    ax = axes[0]
    ax.bar(x, kwh_before, width=bar_w, color=KWH_COLOR, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
    for j, v in enumerate(kwh_before):
        ax.text(x[j], v + 15, f"{v:,.0f}",
                ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
                fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold", color="#333333")

    ax.set_ylabel("Before HP", fontsize=12, fontfamily="GT Planar",
                  fontweight="bold", color="#333333", labelpad=10)

    # --- Panel 2: After HP (base + incremental hatched) ---
    ax = axes[1]
    base = np.minimum(kwh_before, kwh_after)
    inc = kwh_after - base

    ax.bar(x, base, width=bar_w, color=KWH_COLOR, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
    ax.bar(x, inc, bottom=base, width=bar_w,
           color=KWH_COLOR_LIGHT, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0)
    ax.bar(x, inc, bottom=base, width=bar_w,
           facecolor="none", edgecolor=KWH_HATCH_COLOR, linewidth=0, hatch="//")

    for j in range(len(months)):
        ax.text(x[j], kwh_after[j] + 15, f"{kwh_after[j]:,.0f}",
                ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8,
                fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontweight="bold", color="#333333")

    ax.set_ylabel("After HP", fontsize=12, fontfamily="GT Planar",
                  fontweight="bold", color="#333333", labelpad=10)

    # --- Shared formatting ---
    for ax in axes:
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels(months, fontsize=10, fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans")
        ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
        ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
        ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=10)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v:,.0f}"))
        for j, m in enumerate(months):
            if m in WINTER_MONTHS:
                ax.axvspan(j - 0.42, j + 0.42, color="#e8e8e8", alpha=0.35, zorder=0)

    fig.suptitle(title, fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold",
                 fontsize=15, ha="left", x=0.08, y=0.98)
    fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
    return fig
```

```{python}
)
```

## Rate structure diagrams

Proportionally-sized rectangles for supply and delivery rates. Heights are
on the same scale across both utilities so the rectangles are visually
comparable.

```{python}
#| label: rate-diagram-helper

from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle as Rect

SCALE_MAX = 30.0  # ¢/kWh — visual ceiling; keeps both utilities comparable

SUPPLY_FILL = "#fc9706"
SUPPLY_ACCENT = "#e08805"
DELIVERY_FILL = "#68bed8"
DELIVERY_ACCENT = "#3ea8c6"


def _rate_label(
    ax: plt.Axes, x: float, y: float, rate: float, color: str,
) -> None:
    """Draw '¢X.X/kWh' centered above a bar."""
    ax.text(x, y, f"¢{rate:.1f}/kWh", ha="center", va="bottom",
            fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold", fontsize=20, color=color)


def plot_rate_diagram(
    supply_rate: float,
    delivery_default: float,
    delivery_hp_summer: float,
    delivery_hp_winter: float,
    title: str,
) -> plt.Figure:
    """Two-row diagram: supply (orange, top) and delivery (blue, bottom).

    All bars are the same width. Heights are proportional to the rate (¢/kWh)
    on a shared SCALE_MAX so utilities are visually comparable.
    Left = default (flat year-round). Right = HP rate (summer | winter split
    with a gray divider).
    """
    bar_w = 2.0
    bar_gap = 0.12
    row_gap = SCALE_MAX * 0.45

    # X positions
    default_x = 1.5
    summer_x = 6.0
    winter_x = summer_x + bar_w + bar_gap
    divider_x = summer_x + bar_w + bar_gap / 2

    # Y bases (supply on top)
    delivery_base = 0.0
    supply_base = SCALE_MAX + row_gap

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 7))
    ax.set_xlim(0, winter_x + bar_w + 1.0)
    ax.set_ylim(-SCALE_MAX * 0.10, supply_base + SCALE_MAX + SCALE_MAX * 0.12)

    def draw_bar(x, y_base, h, fill, accent):
        ax.add_patch(Rect((x, y_base), bar_w, h, fc=fill, ec="none"))
        ax.hlines(y_base, x, x + bar_w, colors=accent, linewidths=3,
                  capstyle="butt")

    # --- Supply row (top, orange) ---
    draw_bar(default_x, supply_base, supply_rate, SUPPLY_FILL, SUPPLY_ACCENT)
    _rate_label(ax, default_x + bar_w / 2, supply_base + supply_rate + 0.4,
                supply_rate, SUPPLY_ACCENT)

    draw_bar(summer_x, supply_base, supply_rate, SUPPLY_FILL, SUPPLY_ACCENT)
    _rate_label(ax, summer_x + bar_w / 2, supply_base + supply_rate + 0.4,
                supply_rate, SUPPLY_ACCENT)

    draw_bar(winter_x, supply_base, supply_rate, SUPPLY_FILL, SUPPLY_ACCENT)
    _rate_label(ax, winter_x + bar_w / 2, supply_base + supply_rate + 0.4,
                supply_rate, SUPPLY_ACCENT)

    # --- Delivery row (bottom, blue) ---
    draw_bar(default_x, delivery_base, delivery_default, DELIVERY_FILL, DELIVERY_ACCENT)
    _rate_label(ax, default_x + bar_w / 2, delivery_base + delivery_default + 0.4,
                delivery_default, DELIVERY_ACCENT)

    draw_bar(summer_x, delivery_base, delivery_hp_summer, DELIVERY_FILL, DELIVERY_ACCENT)
    _rate_label(ax, summer_x + bar_w / 2, delivery_base + delivery_hp_summer + 0.4,
                delivery_hp_summer, DELIVERY_ACCENT)

    draw_bar(winter_x, delivery_base, delivery_hp_winter, DELIVERY_FILL, DELIVERY_ACCENT)
    _rate_label(ax, winter_x + bar_w / 2, delivery_base + delivery_hp_winter + 0.4,
                delivery_hp_winter, DELIVERY_ACCENT)

    # Gray divider line between summer and winter columns
    div_bot = delivery_base - SCALE_MAX * 0.03
    div_top = supply_base + max(supply_rate, SCALE_MAX * 0.5) + SCALE_MAX * 0.06
    ax.vlines(divider_x, div_bot, div_top, colors="#bbbbbb", linewidths=1.5)

    # Arrows (between default and summer columns)
    arrow_kw = dict(arrowstyle="->,head_width=0.25,head_length=0.18",
                    color="#aaaaaa", lw=2.5)
    for base, rate in [(supply_base, supply_rate), (delivery_base, delivery_default)]:
        mid_y = base + rate / 2
        ax.annotate("", xy=(summer_x - 0.3, mid_y),
                    xytext=(default_x + bar_w + 0.3, mid_y),
                    arrowprops=arrow_kw)

    # Season labels (below delivery bars)
    season_y = delivery_base - SCALE_MAX * 0.06
    ax.text(summer_x + bar_w / 2, season_y, "Summer", ha="center", va="top",
            fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontsize=11, color="#888888")
    ax.text(winter_x + bar_w / 2, season_y, "Winter", ha="center", va="top",
            fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans", fontsize=11, color="#888888")

    # Column headers
    header_y = supply_base + SCALE_MAX + SCALE_MAX * 0.08
    ax.text(default_x + bar_w / 2, header_y, "Default rate", ha="center", va="bottom",
            fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold", fontsize=13, color="#333333")
    hp_mid = (summer_x + winter_x + bar_w) / 2
    ax.text(hp_mid, header_y, "HP rate", ha="center", va="bottom",
            fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold", fontsize=13, color="#333333")

    ax.set_title(title, fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold",
                 fontsize=15, loc="left", pad=16)
    ax.axis("off")
    fig.tight_layout()
    return fig
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-diagram-ngrid

    supply_rate=NGRID_SUPPLY_RATE * 100,
    delivery_default=(NGRID_DISTRIBUTION_DEFAULT + NGRID_TRANSMISSION_DEFAULT) * 100,
    delivery_hp_summer=(NGRID_DISTRIBUTION_DEFAULT + NGRID_TRANSMISSION_DEFAULT) * 100,
    delivery_hp_winter=(NGRID_DISTRIBUTION_HP_WINTER + NGRID_TRANSMISSION_HP_WINTER) * 100,
    title="National Grid MA",
)
display_figure(fig_d_ngrid)
```

### Fixed charge (customer charge)

```{python}
#| label: fig-diagram-fc-ngrid
#| fig-cap: "National Grid MA customer charge: default vs. heat pump rate."

FC_FILL = SB_COLORS["midnight"]
FC_ACCENT = "#1a5a7a"
FC_SCALE = 45.0  # $/month — visual ceiling


def _fc_label(ax: plt.Axes, x: float, y: float, val: float) -> None:
    """Draw '$X.XX/mo' centered above a bar."""
    ax.text(x, y, f"${val:.2f}/mo", ha="center", va="bottom",
            fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold", fontsize=20,
            color=FC_ACCENT)


def plot_fc_diagram(
    fc_default: float,
    fc_hp: float,
    title: str,
) -> plt.Figure:
    """Fixed-charge diagram matching the volumetric diagram layout.

    Three columns: default | summer | winter (same value in both seasonal
    columns since the fixed charge is not seasonal — but the columns are
    present so the diagram lines up vertically with the volumetric one).
    """
    bar_w = 2.0
    bar_gap = 0.12
    default_x = 1.5
    summer_x = 6.0
    winter_x = summer_x + bar_w + bar_gap
    divider_x = summer_x + bar_w + bar_gap / 2

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 3))
    ax.set_xlim(0, winter_x + bar_w + 1.0)
    ax.set_ylim(-FC_SCALE * 0.12, FC_SCALE + FC_SCALE * 0.18)

    def draw_bar(x, h):
        ax.add_patch(Rect((x, 0), bar_w, h, fc=FC_FILL, ec="none"))
        ax.hlines(0, x, x + bar_w, colors=FC_ACCENT, linewidths=3,
                  capstyle="butt")

    draw_bar(default_x, fc_default)
    _fc_label(ax, default_x + bar_w / 2, fc_default + 0.3, fc_default)

    draw_bar(summer_x, fc_hp)
    _fc_label(ax, summer_x + bar_w / 2, fc_hp + 0.3, fc_hp)

    draw_bar(winter_x, fc_hp)
    _fc_label(ax, winter_x + bar_w / 2, fc_hp + 0.3, fc_hp)

    # Gray divider
    div_top = max(fc_default, fc_hp) + FC_SCALE * 0.08
    ax.vlines(divider_x, -FC_SCALE * 0.03, div_top,
              colors="#bbbbbb", linewidths=1.5)

    # Arrow
    mid_y = max(fc_default, fc_hp) / 2
    ax.annotate("", xy=(summer_x - 0.3, mid_y),
                xytext=(default_x + bar_w + 0.3, mid_y),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->,head_width=0.25,head_length=0.18",
                                color="#aaaaaa", lw=2.5))

    # Season labels
    ax.text(summer_x + bar_w / 2, -FC_SCALE * 0.06, "Summer",
            ha="center", va="top", fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans",
            fontsize=11, color="#888888")
    ax.text(winter_x + bar_w / 2, -FC_SCALE * 0.06, "Winter",
            ha="center", va="top", fontfamily="IBM Plex Sans",
            fontsize=11, color="#888888")

    # Column headers
    header_y = FC_SCALE + FC_SCALE * 0.10
    ax.text(default_x + bar_w / 2, header_y, "Default rate",
            ha="center", va="bottom", fontfamily="GT Planar",
            fontweight="bold", fontsize=13, color="#333333")
    hp_mid = (summer_x + winter_x + bar_w) / 2
    ax.text(hp_mid, header_y, "HP rate",
            ha="center", va="bottom", fontfamily="GT Planar",
            fontweight="bold", fontsize=13, color="#333333")

    ax.set_title(title, fontfamily="GT Planar", fontweight="bold",
                 fontsize=15, loc="left", pad=16)
    ax.axis("off")
    fig.tight_layout()
    return fig


fig_fc_ngrid = plot_fc_diagram(
    NGRID_CUSTOMER_CHARGE, NGRID_CUSTOMER_CHARGE,
    title="National Grid MA — Customer charge",
)
display_figure(fig_fc_ngrid)
```

## Sources

- **NGrid delivery rates**: D.P.U. 26-71, Exhibit 3 (rate design workbook)
- **NGrid supply rate**: nationalgridus.com residential basic service rate
  table, 2025 fixed-price option (weighted average of three 6-month terms)
- **CMP delivery rates**: Rate Bulletin A-SEASONAL, 7th Rev (Oct 1, 2025);
  Section 44.1 Terms & Conditions (Jan 2025) for transmission
- **CMP supply rate**: MPUC Docket 2024-00165 Standard Offer, flat Jan–Dec 2025
- **Load profiles**: CT CAIRO simulation (Eversource territory,
  `ct_20261015_a`), weighted-average monthly kWh for natgas-heated homes
